summary:
Phase 5 — V2 Exercise Library resolver + demand-driven exercise creation verified. BACKEND: 16/17 in-process tests pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iter64_v2_resolver.py. All resolver-core paths are correct: backfill flips legacy Approved rows to visibility='client_visible'+safe_for_programming=true AND flips non-Approved rows to visibility='coach_only'+safe=false; get_approved_pool filters strictly on {status in [Approved,Live], visibility=client_visible, safe_for_programming=True} and precomputes _name_norm/_name_tokens/_meta_tokens; resolve_exercise_need returns kind='matched' for exact name (score>=100), 'substituted' or 'unresolved' for unknown names, 'unresolved' for empty pool. apply_resolver_to_workouts mutates in place: matched item gets exercise_id+source='v2_library' (no substitute_for), substituted item gets exercise_id+substitute_for+substitution_reason, alien item is DROPPED from w['exercises'] AND filed as a draft request row (status='draft_requested', visibility='coach_only', safe_for_programming=False, needs_louis_review=True) with a corresponding coach_tasks row (task_type='exercise_review'). Dedup verified: second call with same alien name bumps request_count 1→2, appends to request_history, creates no duplicate row, and does NOT create a second coach task. Cap verified: 10 unique aliens → only MAX_REQUESTS_PER_PROGRAMME=5 rows persisted. summarise_workout_v2_health counts are correct. Coach-only API: POST /api/exercise-content/{id}/reject flips status='rejected'+safe_for_programming=False+records reviewer (200); missing id → 404. POST /api/exercise-content/{id}/merge target_id valid → 200 with tgt.request_count += src.request_count, src.status='merged'+merged_into_id set; merge into self → 400. validate_programme reports 'exercise(s) not linked to the V2 Library' error and includes summary.v2_library stats when workouts have missing exercise_id.

ONE FAILURE — a real backend BUG surfaced: GET /api/exercise-content/requests returns 404 in prod because the parametric route GET /api/exercise-content/{ex_id} (registered earlier from feature_exercise_content.py line 410) shadows it. FastAPI matches routes in registration order; 'requests' is treated as an ex_id and the handler returns {'detail':'not found'}. Verified via direct curl with the coach token. This means the coach cannot list draft exercise requests at all until this is fixed. Reject/merge endpoints are fine because their paths contain a second segment (/{id}/reject, /{id}/merge). See action_items for the two fix options.

FRONTEND spot-check on /workout/[id] for a seeded client workout: page renders correctly. Exercise names are library-style ('Dumbbell Goblet Squat', 'Single Arm Dumbbell Row', 'Dumbbell Push Press', 'Band Pull-Aparts', 'Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift', 'Plank to Down Dog'), WHY THIS SESSION block still renders with the coaching context copy, GREEN variant chip is present, FULL/LIGHTER/RECOVERY variant selector renders. No client-facing exposure of the strings 'draft_requested', 'exercise_request', 'coach_review_needed' or 'needs_louis_review' anywhere on the page. Only pre-existing style-deprecation warnings ('shadow*'/'textShadow*') from RN Web.

REGRESSION: iter61 + iter62 suites still fully green. iter59's TestRetryWorkerFullPipeline + iter60's test_programme_shows_build_muscle_after_regenerate fail with 404 'Original roster not found — please re-upload.' — these are pre-existing test-seed dependencies (they require a roster CSV to have been re-uploaded at the start of the run), NOT regressions introduced by Phase 5. iter63 regen path is exercised as part of the fallback template resolver call site (line 2755 in server.py); code inspection shows apply_resolver_to_workouts is wired in at all 4 fallback call sites and the startup hook (line 7004) invokes backfill_client_flags_once().

critical.issue: Route unreachable — shadowed by GET /api/exercise-content/{ex_id} which is registered earlier (feature_exercise_content.py:410 vs feature_v2_resolver.py:514). Path segment 'requests' is captured as ex_id and the parametric handler returns 404 {'detail':'not found'}. This blocks Louis's ability to list pending draft exercise requests entirely. Repro: curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <louis_token>' https://<host>/api/exercise-content/requests → 404. Two clean fixes: (a) rename the endpoint to /api/exercise-requests (recommended, avoids all collision risk with future /{id}/... routes); OR (b) move the @api.get('/exercise-content/requests') decorator so its route is added to the FastAPI router BEFORE the /{ex_id} route — e.g. register feature_v2_resolver as a submodule earlier in server.py, or explicitly re-register just this route at the top via app.add_api_route.

action_items: HIGH — Fix route ordering / naming collision: GET /api/exercise-content/requests is being caught by GET /api/exercise-content/{ex_id}. Recommend renaming to GET /api/exercise-requests (also matches the semantic — these are draft REQUESTS, not exercise-content rows). Update the frontend list screen accordingly. POST /reject and /merge are safe as-is because /{id}/reject and /{id}/merge don't collide with any existing parametric routes.

LOW — Consider having apply_resolver_to_workouts also fold in green-variant unresolved items into the requests cap counter so a workout with 5 aliens in the main list + 5 in green doesn't silently drop all green items without any request record (currently variant items are dropped silently — no request row filed for them).

LOW — feature_v2_resolver.exercise_requests_list default query includes both DRAFT_STATUSES = ('draft_requested', 'coach_review_needed') — but nothing in the codebase ever writes 'coach_review_needed'. Either wire up a transition endpoint or trim the union to 'draft_requested' only.

LOW — resolve_exercise_need treats a substring-contains match ('squat' ⊆ 'goblet squat') as +30 direct-match score. Because min_direct_match=30.0 exactly, this promotes weak substring hits to 'matched' — e.g. any exercise with the token 'squat' in its name can be silently treated as a direct match for a generic 'Squat' prompt. Consider bumping min_direct_match to 40 or raising the substring bonus threshold.
critical_code_review_comments: feature_v2_resolver.apply_resolver_to_workouts — the green-variant branch (lines 462-477) drops unresolved variant items without filing a draft request. Regular-exercise unresolved items DO create a request. Inconsistent — either both should file or both should be silent.

feature_v2_resolver.create_exercise_request_if_missing — dedup query uses `exercise_name` case-insensitive regex without escaping user input for the second half; requested_name goes through re.escape but the OR clause combines two lookups. Correct as-is because requested_name is escaped in the regex, but noting for the audit trail.

feature_v2_resolver — MAX_REQUESTS_PER_PROGRAMME is a module constant with no override for admin-triggered bulk imports. When Louis regenerates a client's programme after importing a large custom exercise set, the 5-per-call cap silently truncates the request queue. Suggest making it a kwarg with default 5.

server.py:2482 and 2755 — apply_resolver_to_workouts is called on the fallback path without passing programme_id, so the resulting draft requests have requested_for_programme_ids=[] and programmes_affected=0 on the coach dashboard. Consider threading the roster's programme_id through if available (see line 4313 which correctly passes it).
feature_v2_resolver.get_approved_pool — hard-coded .to_list(500) cap. If the approved library grows beyond 500 exercises the pool will silently truncate. Add a warning log if the cap is hit.

Verified pool loader currently returns 3 real seeded exercises + the test-only ones during a run.
rca_of_issue: Route-collision RCA: FastAPI builds its route table in the order @api.<method>(path) decorators execute at import time. In server.py, feature_exercise_content is imported early (before feature_v2_resolver at line 7740), so /exercise-content/{ex_id} (GET) is added before /exercise-content/requests (GET). FastAPI's router iterates routes in insertion order and returns on the first match — the {ex_id} pattern matches anything so 'requests' is treated as an id. Because that handler calls db.exercises_v2.find_one({'id':'requests'}) and finds nothing, it raises HTTPException(404,'not found'). Mitigation options: (1) rename endpoint to /api/exercise-requests (cleanest), (2) explicitly re-register the /requests route before /{ex_id} using app.add_api_route in the startup hook, or (3) rearrange imports so feature_v2_resolver's static-path routes register first. Option (1) is safest — no risk of similar collisions creeping in later.
